item.tib: bde drod gos kyi cha rkyen
item.coloph: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa 'di/ grub thob rim gyis brgyud nas su/ kha rag dpal gyi ri khrod du/ 'khrul zhig ldong sgom nam mkha' la/ skal ldan (bdag) gis zhus pa lags/ dge bas rnam mkhyen thob par shog snod med la gsang rgya/ log lta can la sbas rgya/ dam med la gab rgya'o//
